name: YunExpress Cross-Border Line
description: Specialized DDP air freight and end-to-end direct parcel injection for international B2C e-commerce orders.
fullDescription: YunExpress is an international logistics carrier specializing in cross-border B2C parcel shipping. Providing direct postal injection into national courier networks like USPS, Royal Mail, and La Poste, it delivers 4-8 business day shipping from Asian fulfillment centers directly to international consumer doorsteps.
features: Direct DDP parcel injection with prepaid customs duties and VAT
Fast 4-8 business day transit times from China to US and Europe
End-to-end tracking integration compatible with Shopify and PayPal delivery confirmation
Competitive lightweight gram-based tiered pricing ideal for consumer goods
Local return and re-labeling hubs in North America and Western Europe
